newsitem.title: USA: First Financial holder withdraws slate.
newsitem.headline: First Financial holder withdraws slate.

text.p: Seymour Holtzman, the largest individual shareholder of First Financial Corp of Western Maryland, said he will withdraw his proposed independent slate of directors after talks with the company's management.
Holtzman said in a statement that conversations with the bank's management and representatives of Alex. Brown & Sons have convinced him that the bank is seeking prospective acquirers.
The Securities and Exchange Commission gave Holtzman final approval of his proxy materials on September 13, 1996, which included a proposed slate of four independent directors, he said.

"(Chairman, president and chief executive officer) Patrick Coyne and the bank's management should be commended on their actions. It is obvious that the stock's move from 21 to 26 reflects shareholders' approval of the bank's decision to seek a sale or merger," Holtzman said.
